# Testing intra-species the hourglass model

Statistically test whether the two cell lineages (fusiform & ray lineages) share higher transcriptomic similarity at mid stage

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(magrittr)
```

## Annotate cell lineage

```{r}
sample_name <- "egr_tenx_batch1"
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  Read10X(glue::glue(params$path_10x, sample=sample_name)),
  project = sample_name
)
```

Normalize data

```{r}
seurat_obj %<>% SCTransform
```

Run PCA

```{r}
set.seed(42)
seurat_obj %<>% RunPCA()
DimPlot(seurat_obj)
```

Clustering in the PCA space

```{r}
set.seed(42)
seurat_obj %<>% FindNeighbors()
seurat_obj %<>% FindClusters()
```

Run UMAP

```{r}
set.seed(42)
seurat_obj %<>% RunUMAP(dims=1:30)
DimPlot(seurat_obj)
```
